biased_opinion.verdict: No Course, No Calendar, No Plan
biased_opinion.summary: Gravel Medellín is a legitimate UCI Gravel World Series concept, but it is not currently a plan-ready race. The official calendar update canceled the August 2026 edition and moved the event to the 2027 season without an exact date. The official event page still publishes no course beyond 'More information later.'
strengths: Official UCI Gravel World Series event concept
biased_opinion.bottom_line: Keep the race in the database, but do not sell a training plan or book travel until the organizer publishes a date and course.

final_verdict.one_liner: A real UCI event name without a current race specification.
final_verdict.should_you_race: Not yet. Wait for an exact 2027 date, course, and registration announcement.
final_verdict.alternatives: For a completed Colombian UCI gravel course with verified facts, compare Gravel Bogotá.
